F.meaning: Measured whole-frame power fractions, normalized centroid/concentration and original-frame low-rise/decay; f0 excluded and context unknown explicit. Exact charts are correctness evidence, not musical improvement.

F2.gainScope: Fixed distinct raw-burst peak for gains0.1/0.3/1, not arbitrary-flat argmax invariance.
F2.peakSearch: Complete[f,f+ceil(n/hop)] earliest rawLFpower maximum; pre=f-lag;post=peak+lag. Missing search omitted, missing context unknown. Original timestamps never moved.
F2.limits: All32 synthetic physical attacks have positive proxy;92.9ms minimum1.67707e-5 remains a weak plateau response, not strong decay for every duration.
